page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number left and "EMBLEMA" centred; title heading in italic capitals with continuation line; a woodcut emblem engraving in the middle (not transcribed as text); four lines of italic verse below the picture; catchword-like signature "EXCEL-" at lower right.

main_text.head: VIRTVTES VITIIS INQVINAN-tur, vt virtutes esse desinant.

p.i: Viuit in hoc æuo nemo, qui criminis exsors
Exstet, & à vitiis libera corda gerat:
Ne tamen enormes magno cum crimine lapsus

page.notes: The woodcut shows a goat standing on hind legs, holding a jug or urn on its horns, flanked by two wolves or dogs attacking it; it is an engraving, not text. The word "EXCEL-" at lower right is a catchword-style line, given here as a foot line. The verse lines are italic; the long s is written as s and the ligature forms are normalised. The "Viuit" first line has a faint mark above "nemo" which may be a printed accent.
